description: This file defines the SessionInstallManager class responsible for managing app installation sessions, pre-approvals, and updates on Android devices within the fdroid project. It handles session creation, auto-update support checks, pre-approval requests, and installation processes, including user confirmation flows.

classes.name: SessionInstallManager
classes.description: Manages app installation sessions, including pre-approvals, auto-updates, and user confirmation flows within the fdroid project.

methods.name: isAutoUpdateSupported
methods.description: Checks if auto-update is supported based on target SDK and Android SDK version.

methods.name: requestPreapproval
methods.description: Requests installation pre-approval, possibly involving user confirmation, depending on device and SDK version.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs app installation, handling session creation, progress, and result, including user confirmation if needed.

methods.name: requestUserConfirmation
methods.description: Requests user confirmation for installation, handling the result asynchronously.

methods.name: getSessionParams
methods.description: Constructs session parameters for app installation sessions based on package name and size.

methods.name: canDoAutoUpdate
methods.description: Determines if auto-update is feasible based on app version and device capabilities.

methods.name: getInstallIntentSender
methods.description: Creates an IntentSender for installation-related broadcasts.
